calls.reasoning: Guidance midpoint (rev +10% to ~$112.7B, GM 47.5%, opex $19.25B, OIE $0.35B, tax 16.5%, ~14.63B shares) implies ~$1.98; consensus $1.98-2.00, whisper $2.07.
